flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:7860/demo/?bug=1 then locate the email input field
type a valid email address (e.g., test@example.com)
click the 'Join the waiting list' button
and verify that a welcome message confirming placement on the list appears on the page.

summary:
The page accepted the valid email and the Join button was clicked, but the submission did not update the page to show the welcome message.
Fix the waiting-list submission flow so a successful valid submission replaces or updates the form with a visible welcome message, then add a test that checks this message after clicking Join.
